academy.frontierhunts.course.archery.bri: The last Ranger Academy course puts every bow shot together. Shoot field points into the paper at 10, 20, 30 and 40 yards, then switch to broadheads for the deer: a heart or lung shot on the two 3D deer, on the walking deer, and from the tree stand on the deer below it. A vital hit drops the deer with the kill cam; anything else is called out and the deer resets. Watch the wind flags at long range. Shots only count from behind the shooting line (the stand deer only from the stand).

onboard.frontierhunts.start.p1: Welcome, hunter. Hunting here works like the real thing: animals smell you on the wind and only drop to a well-placed shot. This book gets you there one step at a time. Do the next step and it ticks itself.
onboard.frontierhunts.start.pack: You start with this Handbook, a Field Recurve Bow and 3 arrows. Everything else you make or earn, and every recipe is in this book.
onboard.frontierhunts.start.title: Your first hour
onboard.frontierhunts.station.campfire: Campfire: right-click the fire with the meat
onboard.frontierhunts.station.fit: Crafting grid, or whole stacks at the Bow Tuning Rack
onboard.frontierhunts.step.1.p1: Punch a tree to get logs. Turn logs into planks, planks into sticks, and four planks into a crafting table.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.1.p2: Place the table and use it: almost everything in Frontier Hunts is made on it.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.1.title: Make a crafting table
onboard.frontierhunts.step.2.p1: You have a Field Recurve Bow and only 3 arrows, so make more. Primitive Arrows need flint, a stick and a feather. Hunting Arrows need an iron nugget, coal and a feather, and you get 4 at a time.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.2.p2: Practise on a Shooting Target, then walk up and pull your arrows back out. The Ranger Academy's Archery Range comes later, as its last course.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.2.p3: To shoot, hold Use to draw and let go to release. A full draw flies flatter and hits harder.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.2.title: Make arrows
onboard.frontierhunts.step.3.p1: The tip decides what an arrow does. Field points are for practice: they punch clean holes in targets. Broadheads are for hunting: their blades make animals bleed. Your starter arrows have broadheads.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.3.p2: To change a tip, put an arrow and a tip in a crafting grid. The Bow Tuning Rack fits whole stacks at once and also makes bows.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.3.title: Bow workbench & arrow tips
onboard.frontierhunts.step.4.p1: Deer smell you long before they see you. Check the wind with a Wind Checker and walk with the wind in your face.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.4.p2: Look for tracks, rubs and scrapes, and press Use on one up close to read it. Glass open ground from high up with Binoculars, then sneak in crouched.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.4.p3: These are Field School lessons 1 to 4. Each one has a free practice course.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.4.title: Find game & read sign
onboard.frontierhunts.step.5.p1: Wait until the deer stands calm and side-on. Aim just behind the front leg, a third of the way up: the heart and lungs.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.5.p2: Hit there and the deer drops on the spot and you see the kill cam. Hit anywhere else and it runs. Then follow the blood: press Use on the drops to read them.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.5.title: Your first hunt
onboard.frontierhunts.step.6.p1: Make a Contour Skinning Knife. Hold it, right-click the downed animal and stay close until skinning is done. You get meat, hide and a trophy.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.6.p2: Cook meat on a campfire: right-click the fire with it and wait. Raw meat goes bad and the cold hurts in winter, so eat game and keep warm.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.6.title: Butcher, cook & stay alive
onboard.frontierhunts.step.7.p1: Tan hides and furs on a Tanning Rack. At the Clothing Table, turn them into fur hats, coats and boots for the cold.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.7.p2: Pitch a tent to rest and keep your gear out in the wild. Tents are made from canvas.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.7.title: Camp, clothing & furs
onboard.frontierhunts.step.8.p1: Ready for bigger game? Build a Weapons Workbench and a rifle, then sight it in on The Range in the Ranger Academy.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.8.p2: Open the Expedition journal for Mara's campaign: missions across the reserve, contracts and rewards. Your first report counts the biomes you visit.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.8.p3: Then finish the Ranger Academy with its last course, The Archery Range: paper from 10 to 40 yards, 3D deer, a walking deer and a tree-stand shot. A deer you take with a bow counts too.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.8.title: Rifles, expeditions & archery

onboard.frontierhunts.task.archery.title: Pass the Archery Range

onboard.frontierhunts.task.arrows.title: Make arrows

onboard.frontierhunts.task.rifle.title: Get a rifle
